citation.authors: Zvolensky MJ, Garey L, Gallagher MW, Cheney MK et al

cited_by.title: Coping with anxiety day to day

record.population: 822 US adults with raised anxiety or depression (25.1% African American, 25.3% American Indian, 24.6% Latinx, 25.1% non-Latinx White)
record.design: Randomised trial of two smartphone programmes (anxiety-sensitivity reduction against mindfulness and relaxation), 6-month follow-up
record.finding: Differences between the two programmes were small and not statistically significant. Within each group anxiety, depression and anxiety sensitivity fell over the follow-up. Subgroup patterns by race and ethnicity varied but the study was not powered to test them.
record.note: Done during the COVID-19 pandemic; no no-treatment group, so the falls may not be due to the programmes.
